Known Mori-Smith Hessian identity in the present conventions; split-block candidate using the existing elliptic comparison; nonzero second-order discrepancy with commuting the central expression.

Universal polynomial central cubic; smooth classical fiber iff lambda^3 != -3; PBW and central-quotient flatness at every Artin truncation; character eigenspaces. Restriction G2=c(lambda)[xyz] assumes marked equivariant reconstruction.
